GOAL: Mirror a set of "shop panel P0" improvements (already implemented on the HOST side) into the LAN CLIENT shop panel: `scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd` (742 lines, a pure `_draw`-based shop UI behind a CanvasLayer, fed by `feed(o: Dictionary)` and using `ItemDatabase` + `UiKit`). Only edit `scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd` (you may read anything). Do NOT modify `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd`, `scripts/ui/RosterView.gd`, `scripts/ui/UiKit.gd`, `scripts/net/NetSession.gd` or `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`.

HOST BEHAVIOUR TO MIRROR (reference implementations in `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd`: `_refresh_shop_grid`, `_update_shop_detail`, `_refresh_owned_items`, `_open_shop`, helpers `_shop_affordable_count`, `_shop_list_for`, `_attr_tint`, `_attr_glyph`, inner class `ItemIconBox`):

1) Grid item cards — three visual states plus inline buy:
   - unaffordable: dim the whole card (~0.64) and draw the price in red `Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.40)`;
   - can synthesize (components owned, pay = `ItemDatabase.get_synthesis_cost(id, owned) < cost`): show a green tag `可合成` and show price as `差价 N 金`;
   - recommended: show a gold `★推荐` tag (use the client's own recommended data if it exists in the payload/`_plan()`; if not available, skip this tag);
   - owned: green `已拥有` tag;
   - each affordable card gets a small inline "买" button on its right side; clicking it buys immediately (`buy(id)`) without necessarily changing the selection. Unaffordable cards show `差N` inside a disabled-looking button. Keep card click = select (existing behaviour).
   - Selection memory: do not force-reset the selected item to the first entry on every redraw; keep the current selection if it still exists, otherwise fall back to the first affordable item.

2) Header/categories:
   - header text shows gold and the number of currently affordable items (`可买 N 件`) — compute by summing affordability across categories;
   - each category tab shows a small count badge of affordable items in that category;
   - if the client payload contains enough data to list the hero's recommended build, add a leading `推荐` tab; if not, skip it (do not invent data).

3) Detail column: keep existing content but restructure into
   - a fixed header (item icon, tier, name, `总价 / 素材抵扣 / 实付`);
   - a scrollable body containing the synthesis path drawn as small quality-colored icon boxes (`UiKit.item_icon(self, rect, tier, name)`) with `已合成` / `+N金` labels instead of plain text, plus equipment stats as icon+value chips (small glyph via a simple shape or text, tinted orange for physical / violet for magic / green for defense), and passive/active wrapped text;
   - a fixed bottom action bar (not scrolling) with the buy button (`购买 N 金` gold-filled / `还差 N 金` red disabled / `已拥有` disabled) and, when owned, a sell button (`出售 +N`). Wire them to the existing `buy(id)` / `sell_slot(slot)` APIs.

4) Owned items bar: draw 6 fixed slots using `UiKit.item_icon` with the item's quality color; empty slots draw a dark box with `空`.

CONSTRAINTS:
- The project treats GDScript warnings as errors: every local var inferred from a Variant must have an explicit type (e.g. `var x: float = ...`, `var s: String = str(v)`, `var a: Array = ...`), and `class_name` must come after `extends` (this file already has `class_name NetShopPanel` then `extends Control` — keep it).
- Reuse the file's existing helpers (`_us()`, `_text()`, `_box()`, `_badge()`, `_button()`, `_tier_color()`, `_cat_style()`, `_panel_rect()`) and its constants (PANEL_W, GRID_L/R, DETAIL_L/R, CARD_H, BADGE, etc.). Keep the public API used by `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd` unchanged: `feed(o: Dictionary)`, `toggle()`, `show_panel()/hide_panel()`, `visible`, `_process`.
- Keep the code compact (~100-250 changed lines). Do not refactor unrelated parts, do not add new files.

VERIFY (must do):
1. `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path .cache` then copy the Godot binary to `.cache\godot47.exe`:
   `Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe' -Destination '.cache\godot47.exe' -Force`
2. Make a temp probe dir `devsync/` with `check.tscn` + `check.gd` that does `print("OK ", load("res://scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd") is GDScript)` and quits; run:
   `Start-Process .cache\godot47.exe -ArgumentList '--headless','--path','.','res://devsync/check.tscn','--quit-after','300' -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput devsync\c.out -RedirectStandardError devsync\c.err` then wait, and grep the output for `SCRIPT ERROR` / `Parse Error`.
3. Also run the real scene: `--headless --path . res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 150` and confirm no `SCRIPT ERROR` / `Parse Error`.
4. Cleanup: `Get-Process godot47 | Stop-Process -Force`, `Remove-Item devsync -Recurse -Force`, `Remove-Item .cache -Recurse -Force`.

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.

tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. 120: # 中文按字符宽度折行（host Label 无 autowrap 会溢出，复刻时收进详情列宽）
121: func _wrap(txt: String, max_w: float, sz: float) -> Array:
122: 	var out := []
123: 	var cur := ""
124: 	var cur_w := 0.0
125: 	for i in range(txt.length()):
126: 		var ch := txt[i]
127: 		var w := _f.get_string_size(ch, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, sz).x
128: 		if cur != "" and cur_w + w > max_w:
129: 			out.append(cur)
130: 			cur = ch
131: 			cur_w = w
132: 		else:
133: 			cur += ch
134: 			cur_w += w
135: 	if cur != "":
136: 		out.append(cur)
137: 	return out

188: func _items_of_tab(t: int) -> Array:
189: 	var out := []
190: 	var ids = CATS.get(_tab_labels[clampi(t, 0, _tab_labels.size() - 1)], [])
191: 	for id: String in ids:
192: 		if not ItemDatabase.get_item(id).is_empty():
193: 			out.append(id)
194: 	# host：tier 高→低，同 tier 价格高→低
195: 	out.sort_custom(func(a, b): return _sort_rank(a) > _sort_rank(b))
196: 	return out

198: func _sort_rank(id: String) -> float:
199: 	var it: Dictionary = ItemDatabase.get_item(id)
200: 	return float(int(it.get("tier", 1)) * 100000) + float(int(it.get("cost", 0)))

202: func _slot_of(id: String) -> int:

205: func _has_component(id: String) -> bool:

214: func _bonus_totals() -> Dictionary:

216: 	for id in _equip:

300: func _draw_grid(panel: Rect2, rs: float) -> void:
301: 	# host ScrollContainer(anchor 0.02..0.56, top 110, bottom -34) + GridContainer 2 列
302: 	var gx0 := panel.position.x + PANEL_W * GRID_L
303: 	var gx1 := panel.position.x + PANEL_W * GRID_R
304: 	var gy0 := panel.position.y + GRID_TOP
305: 	var gy1 := panel.end.y + GRID_BOTTOM
306: 	var list := _items_of_tab(_tab)
307: 	if _sel == "" and not list.is_empty():
308: 		_sel = str(list[0])
309: 	var gap := 6.0 * rs
310: 	var row_gap := 4.0 * rs
311: 	var card_w := ((gx1 - gx0) - gap) * 0.5
312: 	var rows_vis := maxi(1, int((gy1 - gy0 + row_gap) / (CARD_H + row_gap)))
313: 	var max_scroll := maxi(0, ceili(float(list.size()) / 2.0) - rows_vis)
314: 	_scroll = clampi(_scroll, 0, max_scroll)
315: 	var start := _scroll * 2
316: 	for n in range(start, mini(list.size(), start + rows_vis * 2)):
317: 		var id: String = str(list[n])
318: 		var col := (n - start) % 2
319: 		var row := int((n - start) * 0.5)
320: 		var r := Rect2(gx0 + col * (card_w + gap), gy0 + row * (CARD_H + row_gap), card_w, CARD_H)
321: 		_draw_card(r, id, rs)

323: func _draw_card(r: Rect2, id: String, rs: float) -> void:
324: 	_hot.append({"r": r, "k": "item", "a": id})
325: 	var it: Dictionary = ItemDatabase.get_item(id)
326: 	var tier := int(it.get("tier", 1))
327: 	var tcol := _tier_color(tier)
328: 	var owned := _slot_of(id) >= 0
329: 	var can := _afford(id)
330: 	var sel := id == _sel
331: 	# host _item_card_style(tier, selected)
332: 	var bg := Color(0.1, 0.12, 0.2, 0.96) if sel else Color(0.04, 0.06, 0.1, 0.9)
333: 	var bc := tcol if sel else Color(tcol.r, tcol.g, tcol.b, 0.35)
334: 	_box(r, bg, bc, 1, 8)
335: 	var cs := _cat_style(_cat_of(id))
336: 	_badge(r.position + Vector2(8.0, (CARD_H - BADGE) * 0.5), BADGE, str(cs[0]), cs[1], tcol, 26.0)

579: # 最深一层缺失的素材件（主机 _find_missing_basic 镜像）
580: func _missing_basic(target_id: String) -> String:
581: 	var target := ItemDatabase.get_item(target_id)
582: 	if target.is_empty() or not target.has("requires"):
583: 		return target_id
584: 	for req_id: String in target.get("requires", []):
585: 		var need := 0
586: 		for r in target["requires"]:
587: 			if str(r) == req_id:
588: 				need += 1
589: 		if _owned_n(req_id) < need:
590: 			return _missing_basic(req_id)

593: # 下一件（推荐买的第一个：素材齐→合成大件；否则→最底层素材；槽满→补差价合成/升级已有件）
594: func _plan_next(plan: Array) -> String:
595: 	if _equip.size() >= 6:
596: 		# 1. 推荐列表里能补差价合成的（至少持有一件素材）
597: 		for id in plan:
598: 			if _owned_n(id) > 0:
599: 				continue
600: 			for req_id: String in ItemDatabase.get_item(id).get("requires", []):
601: 				if _owned_n(req_id) > 0:
602: 					return id
603: 		# 2. 升级已有低级装（2 阶→合大件 / 1 阶→先合中阶）
604: 		for owned_id in _equip:
605: 			var ot := int(ItemDatabase.get_item(str(owned_id)).get("tier", 1))
606: 			if ot >= 3:
607: 				continue
608: 			if ot == 2:
609: 				for rid in plan:
610: 					if _owned_n(rid) > 0:
611: 						continue
612: 					if str(owned_id) in ItemDatabase.get_item(rid).get("requires", []):
613: 						return rid
614: 			else:
615: 				for rid in plan:
616: 					if _owned_n(rid) > 0:
617: 						continue
618: 					for mid_id: String in ItemDatabase.get_item(rid).get("requires", []):
619: 						if _owned_n(mid_id) > 0:
620: 							continue
621: 						if str(owned_id) in ItemDatabase.get_item(mid_id).get("requires", []):
622: 							return mid_id
623: 		# 3. 兜底第一个未拥有
624: 		for id in plan:
625: 			if _owned_n(id) == 0:
626: 				return id
627: 		return str(plan[0]) if not plan.is_empty() else ""
628: 	# 未满槽：素材齐→合成大件；否则最底层缺失件
629: 	for id in plan:
630: 		if _owned_n(id) > 0:
631: 			continue
632: 		if ItemDatabase.can_build(id, _equip):
633: 			return id

635: 		if _owned_n(id) > 0:

637: 		var miss := _missing_basic(id)
638: 		if miss != "":
639: 			return miss
640: 	return ""

642: # 现在补多少钱能到手（总价 - 已拥有素材折价）
643: func _need_cost(id: String) -> int:
644: 	var it := ItemDatabase.get_item(id)
645: 	if it.is_empty():
646: 		return 0
647: 	var cost := int(it.get("cost", 0))
648: 	for req_id: String in it.get("requires", []):
649: 		var need := 0
650: 		for r in it["requires"]:
651: 			if str(r) == req_id:
652: 				need += 1
653: 		var own := mini(_owned_n(req_id), need)
654: 		if own > 0:
655: 			cost -= own * int(ItemDatabase.get_item(req_id).get("cost", 0))
656: 	return maxi(cost, 0)

1065: func _shop_affordable_count(hero, cat: String) -> int:
1066: 	var n := 0
1067: 	for id in _shop_list_for(cat, hero):
1068: 		var it = ItemDatabase.get_item(str(id))
1069: 		if it.is_empty(): continue
1070: 		var tier: int = int(it.get("tier", 1))
1071: 		if hero.equipment_slots.has(str(id)) and tier >= 3: continue
1072: 		var pay: int = int(it["cost"])
1073: 		if it.has("requires"):
1074: 			pay = ItemDatabase.get_synthesis_cost(str(id), hero.equipment_slots)
1075: 		if int(hero.gold) >= pay: n += 1
1076: 	return n

2. draw scroll body content (synthesis path icon boxes, stats chips, passive/active).
3. draw header background (panel-ish black, maybe subtle) and header content.

Content height computation needed for clamping `_dscroll`: track max y; `_dbody_h = max(0, y_end - body_top)`; clamp `_dscroll` to [0, max(0, content_h - body_h)]. But since drawing computes content, we can compute content height in a first layout pass? That is, draw and record final y, then clamp next frame. Simpler: during draw, compute y_end; at end set `_dscroll = clampf(_dscroll, 0, maxf(0, y_end - body_bottom))`? That would clamp after drawing. Next frame it's correct; a single frame overshoot is fine but can jitter. Better do two passes: a lightweight measure pass and a draw pass. That doubles code. Alternative: content is short enough mostly (~header + synthesis + attrs + passive ≈ 400px) and body height ~ (1400-34-110) - 92 - 56 ≈ 1100, so no scroll needed most times but passive text could be long, still under. So `_dscroll` mostly 0; we can just clamp to max(0, y_end + scroll offset - body_h) at end. Fine.

Hmm, but requirement says scrollable body. Wheel over detail increments `_dscroll`; even if content underflows it stays 0. That's acceptable. We can implement content height by storing `_dcontent_h` computed during draw and clamp in wheel handler. But since draw only happens when visible, store after draw. In wheel, `_dscroll = clampf(_dscroll + dir*40, 0, maxf(0, _dcontent_h - _dbody_h))` using last measured values. And at end of draw recompute. Good enough.

Mirror host: each direct require, 40x40 icon + label to the right; wrap rows. Missing ones dim: UiKit.item_icon has no dim param; draw then overlay dark rect at 0.35 alpha? UiKit.font likely system font). Safer to use Chinese single chars: 攻, 法, 速, 暴, 穿, 血, 甲, 抗, 韧, 冷, 蓝, 回. Draw as a small colored rounded box (18x18) with glyph text centered. That's "simple shape or text". Good, and meets "tinted orange for physical / violet for magic / green for defense". Implement `_attr_tint` mirroring host and `_attr_glyph` map to chars.

content.text:
Looks good. Issues to consider:

1. `_dbody_h` and scroll clamp: content height uses `y` final, but sections that are skipped due to body_bot don't advance beyond. In totals loops we `break` at body_bot - 16, so y stops near bottom. Then the plan section `if y < body_bot - 30` may still run if break left y below; okay. `_dbody_h` then underestimates if there's more content beyond break. This means scrolling can't reveal content below because the loop doesn't advance y beyond the bottom. But since rows are break-limited, content height is capped at view height; scroll never needed for totals list (host also clips). The plan section is reachable only if room. Actually with `_dscroll`, when scrolled down, `y` starts above body_top, so the totals loop starts earlier and `break` at body_bot; the plan still may not be reached because y at break near bottom. Hmm. To measure total content, we shouldn't break based on body_bot during measurement, but drawing and layout are combined. For long totals lists, the plan below is unreachable. But totals rows are 16 rows * ~18 = 288 px; body height ~900, so no break. Not an issue in practice. Passive text could be long (some passives long, wrapped maybe 10 lines = 175px). Total ~600; body ~900. Fine. Scroll rarely needed. 

2. `_draw_detail` header title `"[品级]  类别"` with two spaces. Fine.

3. Header text gold.

4. `_draw_card` recompute `_plan()` per card (up to 40 cards/frame) — `_plan()` cached; `_rec_ready()` calls `_plan()`; fine.

5. `_afford_count` called 9 times in tabs + 8 header = 17 times/frame, each ~30 items with `get_item` and `_need_cost` (which iterates requires and `_owned_n`). ~500 iterations per frame. At 60fps, ~30k; acceptable but could be optimized. Not required. But `_process` redraws every frame while visible → yes. 30k dict lookups/s is fine in GDScript? Maybe ~1-2ms/frame. Could cache counts keyed by gold/equip but complexity. Keep.

6. Selection memory: `_draw_grid` picks first affordable; if none, first. Good. But on first `_draw` after feed with `_sel` retained from previous hero, if `_sel` exists in new list it keeps (fine). `_sel` might be an item not in the current tab; fallback. Good.

1. `_dbody_h` and scroll clamp: content height uses `y` final, but sections that are skipped due to body_bot don't advance beyond. In totals loops we `break` at body_bot - 16, so y stops near bottom. Then the plan section `if y < body_bot - 30` may still run if break left y below; okay. `_dbody_h` then underestimates if there's more content beyond break. This means scrolling can't reveal content below because the loop doesn't advance y beyond the bottom. But since rows are break-limited, content height is capped at view height; scroll never needed for totals list (host also clips). The plan section is reachable only if room. Actually with `_dscroll`, when scrolled down, `y` starts above body_top, so the totals loop starts earlier and `break` at body_bot; the plan still may not be reached because y at break near bottom. Hmm. To measure total content, we shouldn't break based on body_bot during measurement, but drawing and layout are combined. For long totals lists, the plan below is unreachable. But totals rows are 16 rows * ~18 = 288 px; body height ~900, so no break. Not an issue in practice. Passive text could be long (some passives long, wrapped maybe 10 lines = 175px). Total ~600; body ~900. Fine. Scroll rarely needed.

5. `_afford_count` called 9 times in tabs + 8 header = 17 times/frame, each ~30 items with `get_item` and `_need_cost` (which iterates requires and `_owned_n`). ~500 iterations per frame. Could cache counts keyed by gold/equip but complexity. Keep.

At a 2400-wide viewport, rs = 1.0*1.35=1.35. At 1920, rs=1.08. At headless 1152, rs=1.35 (max 1). So fonts 16*1.35=21.6. Cards fixed 76 high. Three lines as computed fit 58.75 baseline. Good.

But the card width at 1920 viewport? The panel is fixed 2000 raw centered; if viewport width is 1920, panel starts at -40 (offscreen edges). That's the existing design; host drawer 2280 raw on design canvas with stretch. The client uses `_panel_rect` raw with `(area.x - 2000)/2`, so at 1920 it's -40. Existing behavior. Not our concern.

Now the action bar's `bh := 46*rs` = 62 at rs 1.35. Buttons at y = end-42-62 = 1296, bottom 1358. Owned bar starts 1360. The detail body ends 1290. Good. In a 1400-high viewport, bar bottom 1358 < 1400.

At a viewport height of 1080 (common), end=1080; bar top 976, bottom 1038; owned 1040..1078; grid bottom 1034 (end-46). Wait grid cards end at gy1=1034, owned starts 1040, action bar bottom 1038. No overlap. Detail body ends 970. Good.

At 1080 height, detail body 206..970 = 764. Content ~915 → scroll needed. Wheel works. Good.

But scroll clamp: `_dview_h=764`, `_dbody_h` computed from y. With content ~915, max scroll 151. Good. But as noted, totals loop breaks at body_bot when scrolled to 0, capping `_dbody_h` at ~764? Let's trace: at `_dscroll=0`, y starts 210. Synthesis ~86 → 296. Attrs ~60 → 356. Passive ~200 → 556. Totals header 30 + rows until y > body_bot-16=954; 10 rows*19=190 → 806. Plan section: y=806 < 924, draw header+line (~47) → 853, button (40) → 893. `_dbody_h = y - body_top + 0 = 893-206=687`? Wait y includes body_top start, so content height 893-206=687 < view 764 → clamp 0. But the actual content extends to 893 absolute, which is < body_bot 970, so it all fits! My earlier estimate 915 was absolute y, not height. Indeed body height 764 at 1080; content height 687 fits. Great. At 648 headless body height 332, content 687 → scroll 355; but the totals loop breaks at body_bot 538: starting y 210, synthesis 86→296, attrs 60→356, passive 200→556 (already >538) — the passive loop draws only visible lines but advances y to 556; totals `if y < body_bot` false (556 > 538), skipped; plan skipped. `_dbody_h=350`, view 332, scroll 18. But content below (totals/plan) is never drawn/measured because we stopped at body_bot. Scrolling down only 18px, can't reach totals. This is a functional limitation for small viewports: content below the fold is not rendered because layout breaks.

To properly support scrolling, the layout must be computed independent of the viewport, and drawing clipped. Our loops break at body_bot, so lower content never gets measured. On typical 1080+ heights it fits; but at 648 it doesn't. Real game is 1080/1440; content ~687 fits at 1080. For long passives, content could exceed and lower sections become unreachable. The requirement says "scrollable body"; we should make it actually scrollable.

Fix: remove/relax body_bot breaks in the totals loop so y advances through all content; draw only when visible. Then `_dbody_h` reflects full content, and scrolling reveals lower content. The plan section condition `if y < body_bot - 30` should instead be `if nxt != ""` and draw only if in view; advance y regardless. Similarly totals loop should not `break` at body_bot; just skip drawing when y > body_bot (and y+fs > body_bot). But the loop over `_bs` could be long; it's finite. Remove break, guard draws:
```
for row in _bs:
    if not... continue
    if y + fs_tot > body_top and y < body_bot:
        draw
    y += ...
```
No break. Plan: always draw header/line/button logically, but only add hot/draw when visible. `_draw_plan_line` with bot clips drawing; for measurement, pass 99999 so it lays out fully. Then button y known; draw if in view.

Not a git repo or git unavailable/exit 1. Mtime 13:32:30 (my last edits around then). Stable.

Now, let me reconsider `_draw_detail` and `_draw_action_bar` for a critical issue: `_draw_action_bar` is called after `_draw_detail`, but the detail body draws content with text that may extend over the area where the action bar is because we clip by y at body_bot. Good. But `_draw_detail` draws its header *after* the body, and then `_draw_action_bar` draws. Fine.

One issue: `_draw_detail` is called after `_draw_owned`, and the body begins at y=206, so it doesn't overlap owned. Good.

One issue: `_draw_grid` selection fallback runs every draw; if `list` is empty, `pick=""`, `_sel=""`; detail empty. Fine.

One issue: `_draw_card`'s card click `_hot` rect includes the whole card; the inline `buy` hot is appended after. But `_hot` also has the tab/owned etc. from earlier draws. Reverse scan: bar buy (later), card buy, card. Clicking a card's inline button hits "buy" first; good. Clicking card elsewhere hits "item". Good.

One issue: `_draw_action_bar` uses `_hot` "buy" but its rect might overlap the detail's hidden plannext hot? plannext only added if fully visible in body, which is above bar. No overlap.

One issue: header count `_afford_count` uses `_need_cost`, which returns 0 for missing items; skip empty. Good.

One issue: `_afford_count("推荐")` may count recommended items that are not in CATS, but `_items_of_tab` also uses plan; fine.

One issue: `_tabs()` calls `_rec_ready()` which calls `_plan()`; `_plan()` uses `HeroPickData.HERO_ROLE.get(_hero_name, "战士")` and `_plan_cache`. If `_hero_name` changes, feed sets `_plan_for=""` so plan recomputes. Good.

One issue: The tab index may shift when `_rec_ready()` transitions false→true. E.g., panel opens before feed sets name (hero_name empty) → tabs 8, `_tab` maybe 0 (物理). Then feed sets name → tabs 9, tab 0 becomes 推荐, so the user's selected category silently changes to 推荐. But the panel becomes visible only after feed; `toggle()` typically after own data exists. Still, on first opening, `_tabs` is computed with hero name. Fine. If the player dies and own feed becomes empty (`_ys.feed({})` maybe not shop; `_sp.feed` still gets own?), `_hero_name` stays. Not an issue.

One issue: `_rec_ready` requires `HERO_ROLE.has(_hero_name)`. `_hero_name` from `own.name`; host uses display_name? NetSession own at line 952 likely `"name": h.display_name`. Check. If it's a different name (e.g., "元流之子" in HERO_ROLE yes). Fine.
